value.rationale: A specified four-factor exemption is a mathematically natural robust variant of a universal factor-coverage monitor. This is a complete classification across all sixteen binary four-patterns, including eight minimal-memory levels, rigorous extremizers and a 625-state reversal asymmetry. These distinct exact right-language complexities are not implied by the known all-factor DFA count. It is a motivated complete finite structural census, not an arbitrary single-case recomputation.
